# MESH_ADMIN

The credential that administers the mesh, as a Secret only its own cluster can read.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `meshAdmin`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.meshAdmin`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
